description.v: Fundly.ai is a fintech platform embedded in the healthcare vertical providing integrated credit, commerce, and payment solutions to the pharma distribution tail — retailers, distributors, and specialty players. Started as supply-chain finance in 2021, expanded into B2B commerce (FundlyMart), transaction/payments infrastructure, and embedded credit.

conflicts.claim_b: B2B pharma distribution platform with embedded credit, commerce (FundlyMart), and payments/settlement infrastructure
conflicts.resolution: phase3 p3 payload disagrees with existing value; existing kept as preferred pending human review
Most defensible: $4M equity + $0.9M venture debt = $4.9M total. ET reports $4M equity; ISN reports $4.9M total including debt. Both are correct in their framing.
Fundly.ai's own support and privacy pages state U74999MH2019PTC328994. Tracxn lists U82990MH2019PTC328994. Company self-declaration preferred.

Fundly.ai is NOT an AI company or general fintech. It is a B2B pharma distribution platform with embedded credit, commerce, and payments. The 'AI' in the name refers to the company brand, not AI technology. One headline (The SaaS News) used 'AI-Native B2B Pharmaceutical Distribution Network' but this is marketing language, not core identity.

products.name: FundlyMart
products.description: B2B ecommerce platform allowing retailers and distributors to discover and order medicines from distributors, with credit embedded into checkout

products.name: Embedded Credit
products.description: Instant top-up credit and custom credit structures for pharma retailers and distributors; lending decisions based on commerce and payment data rather than conventional financial statements

products.name: Payments & Settlement Infrastructure
products.description: Payment and settlement infrastructure integrating with distributor ERP systems to manage collections, payouts, and reconciliation; currently piloting in Pune

products.name: Fundly App
products.description: Mobile app for retailers to apply for loans, complete KYC, track repayment schedules, and manage credit
